craft_notes: Color: surrender-offered (destruction stays live, unclosed). Firing: double-dash holds address inside offering; quickly-yea keeps optative haste; body-body kept (deham twice is the Sanskrit). REJECTED OPTIONS (with killers): (a) colon for ultimatum (v3 device) -> killed: this is surrender, not ultimatum; wrong song-moment. (b) smoothing double body -> killed: repetition is the Sanskrit. Read aloud: THY-flow-er-GAZED bo-dy — NĪ-pa — … I-would re-LEASE-it QUICK-ly, YEA, the BO-dy. Abhinavagupta frame: grove as vibhāva, not backdrop — beauty as cause; kuṭaja-mockery and nīpa-release as anubhāva (consequents), not ornament; rasa overwhelming perception (dust obscuring sun/moon).

lines: I would release it quickly, yea, the body.

reads_against.argmap: Released or destroyed? → Surrender, not destruction.
c1_essence: Beauty is not decoration but cause: the groves shine for Kāma's sake, not the reverse. The grove is the vibhāva (determinant) of śṛṅgāra; the rasa overwhelms perception — dust of passion obscures sun and moon, new-cloud-drunk peacocks cry. The kuṭaja's mockery and the nīpa's release are consequents (anubhāva), not ornament: the poet sides with the humble tree over showy flowers. The bee kisses the yūthikā creeper. The rasa is aesthetic: the rasa IS the point.
